column1: A WSI of colorectal carcinoma with low-grade tumor budding at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a cohesive tumor invasive front, where the advancing edge of the carcinoma is predominantly composed of well-defined glandular structures or large cell clusters, with minimal evidence of scattered single cells or tiny cell groups at the periphery.

A WSI of colorectal carcinoma with intermediate-grade tumor budding at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a moderately disrupted tumor invasive front, showing an admixture of cohesive glandular components and a noticeable scattering of small cell clusters or single cells dissociating into the peritumoral stroma.

A WSI of colorectal carcinoma with high-grade tumor budding at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a highly disorganized and infiltrative tumor border, where the invasive front is dominated by numerous scattered small cell groups and single cells permeating the stroma, with a relative paucity of large, cohesive gland formations.

A WSI of colorectal carcinoma with low-grade tumor budding at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of 0 to 4 isolated single tumor cells or clusters of up to 4 cells (as per ITBCC criteria) within the stroma at the invasive front (hotspot area of 0.785 mm簡), amidst predominantly larger glandular or nested tumor structures.

A WSI of colorectal carcinoma with intermediate-grade tumor budding at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of 5 to 9 isolated single tumor cells or clusters of up to 4 cells (as per ITBCC criteria) within the stroma at the invasive front (hotspot area of 0.785 mm簡), indicating a moderate degree of tumor cell dissociation.

A WSI of colorectal carcinoma with high-grade tumor budding at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of 10 or more isolated single tumor cells or clusters of up to 4 cells (as per ITBCC criteria) densely present within the stroma at the invasive front (hotspot area of 0.785 mm簡), representing prominent tumor cell dissociation and an aggressive growth pattern.
